closingSelfCheck.summary: B-381e M1 delivers a host-neutral read-only resolver (story_authority_resolve) and read-only observability_snapshot adapter that consume resolver rows and run story_export from the authoritative cwd. Three focused smoke tests cover happy/edge/adversarial intents, contract smoke pins L0 read-only policy + process-fact registration and forbids Markdown parsing, direct backing-store reads, dashboard wiring, and production-DONE overclaim. Real CLI transcript (transcript-diff.md) shows worktree authority winning over stale main mirror and localDone/productionDone gap rendered honestly. No UI in M1 as required.
